verdict.rationale: Secrets handling is a fair axis for an infrastructure-as-code tool, but the evidence pack has no documentation of a way to pass secrets or sensitive values while keeping them out of code or logs. The only related first-party item recommends a remote backend for securely storing state, which is not secret injection or log redaction. A community report says secrets end up stored unencrypted in state, so there is no supporting evidence for the story.
